name: llm-router
description: An explainable, policy-driven router for choosing AI models by task, capabilities, cost, latency, privacy and reliability.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @llm-router/core run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/catalog run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/evals run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/observability run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/adapter-openai-compatible run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/adapter-openai run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/adapter-anthropic run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/adapter-google run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/adapter-openrouter run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/proxy run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/cli run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/testing run build && pnpm --filter @llm-router/playground run build
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const path of ['dist','tsconfig.tsbuildinfo','tsconfig.check.tsbuildinfo']) fs.rmSync(path,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test:cli: pnpm cli validate fixtures/policies/default.yaml && pnpm cli doctor --policy fixtures/policies/default.yaml
scripts.release:check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm catalog:validate && pnpm test && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm test:cli && pnpm pack:check
